name: D6 staged representation-versus-objective overfit audit
purpose: identify the first stage at which the current direct response formulation cannot memorize exact TRAIN examples
scope: diagnostic only; cannot authorize DEV, TEST, deployment, or visual transfer

data.selection: same first state and first nested group per episode as the frozen D6 memorization audit

models.stage_transition: warm-start model from prior final checkpoint and reset AdamW
models.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update of every stage

optimization.batching: deterministic full batch with all states and all 64 probes
optimization.loss_weights: unchanged frozen D6 pilot weights for active terms
optimization.gradient_diagnostics: unweighted and weighted gradient norms plus pairwise cosine at stage entry and exit

interpretation.one_state_response_fails: decoder or optimization cannot represent even one fixed action-response map
interpretation.eight_state_response_first_fails: scene conditioning or model capacity cannot store several response maps
interpretation.relational_stage_first_fails: that added objective conflicts with or fails to enforce the required relational structure
interpretation.all_stages_pass: formulation can memorize; held-out failure returns focus to generalization and data diversity
